method.browser: isolated scripted Chrome 153 sessions with touch and keyboard input
limitations: Persona satisfaction is a task-completion proxy, not measured user sentiment.
No real phone, tablet, on-screen keyboard, or screen reader participated in this baseline.
CDP device-pixel-ratio overrides were excluded because their canvas backing-store measurements were inconsistent; process-level high-DPI checks rendered correctly.

personas.label: First-time calculator user on a phone

evidence: The brand, Report and Reset actions, and primary result hierarchy were visible from 320 to 412 CSS pixels.
Gross 767, Murphy yield 92.36%, and expected good approximately 708 were visible and correctly distinguished.
The D0 control was reachable, but its label clipped at 320 and 360 pixels and scripted mobile entry was timing-sensitive.
Invalid alphabetic D0 text remained visible without an inline error and reverted on blur.
The phone workflow selected Poisson and observed the corresponding result.
The compact Report dialog fit at 320 pixels and downloaded JSON successfully.
A 390x844 to 844x390 to portrait cycle preserved state and restored the initial rendering.
Gross, statistical yield, and expected-good results remained prominent in all tablet viewports.
Precise dimensions and D0 were accepted, but common controls were only 32 CSS pixels high.
Disclosure rows opened only when their label-sized hit region was tapped; row whitespace was inactive.
Negative binomial alpha 2.5 and its full-precision details were available in tablet portrait layouts.
The large map and all five legend categories were clear in tablet portrait layouts.
JSON and SVG exports matched the modified inputs, model, alpha, assumptions, and results.
A 744x1133 to 1180x820 to 768x1024 cycle preserved inputs, expanded sections, and outputs.
Visual Tab navigation worked, but the browser accessibility tree exposed an unnamed canvas and unnamed edit agent rather than labeled results and controls.
After an invalid submitted value, focus returned to the canvas and the scripted keyboard recovery path did not complete.
At 320 pixels the negative-binomial alpha field was placed completely outside the visible card.
JSON export succeeded, but focus traversed 26 background controls before reaching the modal format buttons.
Internal canvas content clipped at 320 pixels and the 1180x820 wide layout clipped its right settings edge.
Process-level high-DPI rendering passed, but a full browser text-zoom path was not completed.
Independent geometry and Murphy oracles matched Gross 767, yield 0.9236087801468398, and exact expectation 708.4079343726261 in the UI and JSON.
An independent active-rectangle corner-fit enumerator produced Gross 767 with 147 mm usable radius and 10.12 by 8.12 mm pitch.
The independent Murphy formula produced 0.9236087801468398 and expected good 708.4079343726261.
The modified scenario independently produced Gross 709, yield 0.9001129656572019, and expectation 638.1800926509561.
Phone and tablet JSON and SVG exports preserved inputs, policies, model metadata, and full-precision results.

findings.summary: The negative-binomial alpha field is not visible at 320 CSS pixels
evidence: Observed 320x568 negative-binomial walkthrough.

findings.summary: The browser accessibility tree does not expose labeled calculator semantics
evidence: Chrome accessibility-tree inspection exposed an unnamed canvas and edit agent only.

findings.summary: The Report dialog does not confine keyboard focus
evidence: Twenty-six Tab presses traversed background controls before reaching JSON.

findings.summary: Phone labels and map metadata clip inside the fixed canvas
evidence: Observed at 320 and 360 CSS pixels despite DOM scroll width matching the viewport.

findings.summary: Tablet breakpoints waste 1024 pixels and clip the 1180-pixel wide layout
evidence: 1024x768 remained single-column; 1180x820 clipped the settings card and footer at the right edge.

findings.summary: Touch and disclosure targets are smaller than the intended tablet and phone comfort target
evidence: Common numeric controls were 32 pixels, header controls 38 pixels, and disclosure whitespace was not clickable.

findings.summary: Scenario comparison has no retained baseline or explicit delta
evidence: This pre-existing non-core expert efficiency gap is unchanged and outside the responsive repair scope.
